CFB-week.summary: Four midweek games. Baylor plays its first game since firing Dave Aranda (Joe Klanderman interim, Jake Spavital on offense); UCF keeps starting Keyone Jenkins with Alonza Barnett III out. Tulane's QB job is Trace Johnson's for now but not confirmed, and Troy's QB Goose Crowder and top WR TK Keyes are health questions after the ULM loss.

NBA-SAC-at-NO-1030.summary: New Orleans (0-4) plays the second night of a back-to-back after losing at home to Denver on Oct 28; Jordan Poole left that game with a left ankle injury and is day-to-day. Sacramento remains without Keegan Murray, Ben Simmons and backup centers Raynaud and Cardwell, so Sabonis and Achiuwa carry the frontcourt; no new changes to either team's starters were found.

NFL-CAR-at-GB-1030.summary: Josh Jacobs came back from the exempt list last week, played about half the snaps and took both goal-line snaps, so MarShawn Lloyd is now the backup. Carolina's offensive line is badly thinned: both starting guards are out, Moton is on IR and a rookie starts at right tackle. Green Bay is without Parsons, Franklin, guard Rhyan and tackle Glover, and Matthew Golden is questionable but was upgraded to limited practice Wednesday.

SOCCER-day.summary: No listed player is reported out; Barry, Becker, Mwene and Thauvin appear in predicted XIs, while one preview leaves Bakwa out of Lille's XI. Lecce travel without a suspended defender and four injured players; Atalanta are missing four defenders, but Fiorentina are in poor home form.

fix.summary: Quality-gate checks: Golden upgraded to limited but still questionable; Jacobs carry line matches 15.5 with a split backfield; no availability changes found for the college picks, and no college prop lines could be confirmed.

NBA-GS-at-MIN-1029.summary: Three searches turned up no current (Oct 2026) injury report, beat-writer update or rotation news for this game; results were all from past seasons. The only current status information is the app's own injury feed (MIN without Edwards and DiVincenzo; GS without Porzingis, Butler and Moody, with Lendeborg questionable), which this research could not independently confirm or add to.

NBA-HOU-at-MIL-1029.summary: Houston is without both centers: Alperen Sengun (lower-back soreness, his first missed game of the season) and Steven Adams (soleus strain, out a week or two), so Clint Capela and Tari Eason are in line for more minutes and the frontcourt rebounding is spread across Durant, Smith and Thompson. Marcus Smart (forearm) is questionable. Milwaukee lists no injuries and its usual five should start.
